hints.title: Dynamic Prefix Sum Maintenance
hints.text: Both point updates and range queries occur frequently. An array that is fast for updates must also answer range queries faster than linear scanning.

hints.title: Binary Indexed Tree or Segment Tree
hints.text: A tree representation partitions the array into nested power-of-two intervals, supporting both point updates and prefix sum queries in logarithmic time.

hints.title: Fenwick Tree Formulation Blueprint
hints.text: Build a Fenwick tree of size N + 1. Store the original nums copy. update(i, val) computes delta = val - nums[i], updates nums[i] = val, and adds delta through tree with i += i & -i. sumRange(l, r) evaluates query(r + 1) - query(l).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(log N) update and sumRange, O(N log N) init
variables: N: number of elements in nums
complexity.notes: Fenwick tree with lowbit indexing answers queries and updates in logarithmic steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Naive prefix sum arrays require O(N) per update, causing overall quadratic runtime for Q updates.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear O(N) auxiliary space for Fenwick array balances both operations at O(log N).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct 1-based indexing math using lowbit bit manipulation (i & -i).
